target_customer: Web and app developers who want realtime synced, offline capable data without building sync infrastructure
problem: Developers must stitch together persistence, state management and realtime sync. Triplit offered a full-stack database that syncs between server and client.
business_model: Open source database (AGPL per one source) with a hosted cloud offering

founders.name: Matthew Linkous
prior_employers: Google (launched features on the Search page)

founders.name: Will Ernst
founders.background_notes: Software engineer with finance background per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A database with conflict resolution, query sync and client and server runtimes is hard distributed systems work for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Once an app's data model is built on it migration is costly, but the core was open source and the field had funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Supabase announced on 8 October 2025 that Matt Linkous was joining and described it as an acquisition, with no plan to integrate Triplit into its platform.

market_need_then: Developers used Firebase and Supabase for realtime sync; the local-first movement grew in the following years. No Triplit specific demand evidence from 2021 was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer-focused, The best database for app developers; blog on local-first definitions

branding.community_and_virality: Open source repository and developer blog posts; used in local-first tutorials

brand_strength.rationale: Known within the local-first developer niche through open source and a blog, but the name is confused with unrelated Triple companies in search and no broader brand evidence was found.

outcome_analysis: Triplit began in YC Winter 2021 as a two founder database for app developers, with only a YC-sized investment found in public sources. It built an open source local-first sync database and on 8 October 2025 Supabase announced Matt Linkous was joining in what it called an acquisition, with Triplit remaining open source. The deal terms and Will Ernst's role are not public.
notes: triplit.dev did not resolve from the research environment. Round rests on CB Insights (130K, 1 Feb 2021; PitchBook 125K); no other investor found. The acquisition is reported by Supabase and PitchBook (8 Oct 2025), but Supabase does not say whether the whole company was bought. YC status Inactive agrees with an acquired-and-folded company. No dated 2021 competitor sources found; present-day Firebase and Supabase comparison pages are too late.
